[p align="start"]It’s been almost a week since the Endless update went live, and we’ve been keeping a close eye on how it’s playing out. To be completely honest with you: endless runs are way too long. We never intended Endless to turn into a multi-hour marathon or feel like a grindy chore.
[p align="start"]We want endless runs to be intense, punchy, and respectful of your time.
More Aggressive Scaling: We're significantly ramping up the difficulty scaling so runs naturally wrap up around 50–75 rooms rather than room 500+.

Additional Scaling Parameters: We're adding scaling to more different aspects of the run, while not 100% set in stone things like enemy spawning rate, movement speed, resistance etc. will be scaled now. This will also ramp the difficulty and reduce grind.

Higher Score Gains: To keep the leaderboards fair and competitive, score gains are getting a massive boost. In theory, the same build that used to push room 500 will net a similar score around room 75.
[p align="start"]Because of the deep mechanical changes to scoring and room scaling, any in-progress Endless run will be reset when the patch drops.
[p align="start"](Note: Standard game mode runs are completely safe, this only affects Endless mode!)
⏰ Patch Time: Thursday 27th August at 11:00 CEST

💾 Action Needed: You will NOT be able to use "Continue" on Endless runs started before the update. If you currently have an active Endless run going, please make sure to finish it before Thursday at 11:00 CEST so your score is properly committed to the leaderboards!
[p align="start"]We’re really sorry for any inconvenience this causes, but it's necessary to make sure the leaderboard math stays clean and functional for everyone.
~MeepMeep Games

Our 4th Major Update is officially here! We’ve packed this update with massive new replayability features, extra meta-progression, community-requested features, and more languages!
Ready to see how long you can truly survive?
Play Forever: Pick your difficulty, flip the toggle to Endless, and keep fighting until you finally meet your match!
Climb the Ranks: Score your spot on the leaderboards and prove to the community who the ultimate player is. How far can you push your run?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593605/8b734c7d5c8b7a232e42e41d62dbb1be93d794be.jpg"]
Even more meta progression has arrived! We’ve completely reworked Influencer Charms and added a brand-new progression system to power up your runs:
The Meta-Charm Console: Explore the brand-new console to manage your charms.
Fashion Meets Stats: Find Meta-Charms during your Endless runs and combine your favorite visual looks with powerful stat bonuses!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593605/0724e000a4a93cb98ed85b213147a0c4bc7521c2.png"]
Looking to completely shake up your gameplay? On top of Endless Mode, we’ve added 4 new run modifiers that completely alter how the game plays:
🩸 Fragile: Ultimate glass cannon mode, you have 1 Shield and 1 HP. Every hit removes 1.
☣️ Toxic Environment: The air itself is poisonous! You constantly take a percentage of your current health as damage. Not lethal, but dangerous...
💥 Explosive Deaths: Watch your step, enemies explode when they die!
🎲 Randomizer: Total chaos. Enemy encounters are completely randomized.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593605/008a108624832549abad438534300d79b52d1aad.png"]
You asked for more freedom, and we delivered! We’ve majorly increased the limits on our Custom Options so you can tweak your experience to your heart's content.
(Disclaimer: We are officially NOT responsible for one-shotting, bullet sponges, or fried PCs... play at your own risk! 😉)

Infestation has spread to the vaults, rooms are infected, mutated enemies are crawling out of them, and a new boss is guarding weapon blueprints worth fighting for. The v1.3.0 Infestation Update is out now.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593605/7c9e5985d2a7d8b9bdd3457deac2aa6513b7d38c.jpg"]

Infected rooms bring a new objective: shoot every Infestation Bulb to stop the spread before it overruns the ship. Two new infested enemies spawn from these rooms, and they don't always stay put; sometimes they breach containment and hunt you down elsewhere.
A new boss takes flight with deadly spores, fast aerial strikes, and infected blobs. Beat her and claim the blueprints for the infected weapon.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593605/b653cf526e12a643e6a0fb6fe15de29d97b7d96b.jpg"]
An experimental rifle with a rapid three-round burst. High-impact rounds infect whatever they hit, and the integrated scope plus digital ammo counter keep you sharp in the chaos.

The new Infection element turns the infestation into your weapon. Infected enemies burst into spores that spread to everything nearby, chaining into more infections. It runs on the same three-tier system as the other elements, the rest you'll discover in the field.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593605/6600af65e7ce52bfba70444d35811578296c22c2.png"]

Get ready to blow things up! We’ve just deployed a massive new update for Galactic Vault packed with new grenades, extra enemies and a bunch of new meta-progression!

Before we get into the new features, a quick reminder that our sale is almost ending! If you or your friends have been waiting for the right time to jump in, grab your copy of Galactic Vault NOW before the price goes back up!
There are 4 brand new grenade types, and each grenade can now be upgraded in the HUB. Fully maxing them out unlocks a powerful new effect. We've also upgraded all explosions visuals!
Fragment: The fragment grenades explodes into a bunch of sharp shards
Vortex: The vortex grenade pulls enemies close before exploding
Pulsing: The pulse grenade explodes multiple times, each time increasing it's radius
Smart: The smart grenade scans an area for enemies, then fires seekers towards each target
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593605/760b06a622fe741fe4d5a85124a2c6779ceb382c.gif"]
The Jetpacker: Armed with some sort of flame-thrower and a jetpack for quick repositioning.
The Blade Drone: A fast, lethal new mechanical threat that comes at you with scary looking blades.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593605/048aaa42b7637280a594613c592b2801101da4be.jpg"]

Your favorite firearms just got deeper. Individual weapons now earn their own XP and can be leveled up! Unlock up to 4 stat upgrades per gun, with a bigger final power spike at max level. Weapon prestige unlocks once you reach level 10 on any gun.
Take to the skies with new Rocket Boots or dodge attacks instantly with Blink. We’ve also added a new dedicated movement keybind by popular request.

We've entirely restructured the meta-progression flow so the hub is no longer overwhelming when you first start playing. Plus, the end-of-run screen has been beautifully polished to show parallel XP bars and a brand new 3D Weapon Renderer!

[p align="start"]Today we are incredibly excited to bring you our first major update! We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and v1.1.0 is packed to the brim with new content, difficulty overhauls, balance changes, and much-requested quality-of-life features.
[p align="start"]This update brings a total of 5 playable characters! Each character comes equipped with their own base stats, a unique passive ability, and 4 unlockable perks.
[p align="start"]Perks are gained by leveling up your character, much like with the guns, and will provide powerful additional bonuses to help you survive the vaults!
[p align="start"]Note: Each character also comes with cool custom arms! 😉

notes.title: 🔥 Pushing the Limits: Insane & Impossible Vaults

items.text: [p align="start"]We saw a problem with our difficulty scaling and have decided to add not 1, but 2 EXTRA difficulty levels: Insane & Impossible Vaults.
Starter, Normal & Secure Vaults: Reduced difficulty jump between them, secure is slightly easier as before. Ensuring smooth progression for everyone!
Insane Vaults: A bit harder than our original Secure Vaults, with some extra threats.
Impossible Vaults: The absolute real deal. 20 rooms, extremely difficult, multiple bosses.
The demo is now updated to the release version, with all the fixes, optimizations, QOL and visual improvements we’ve been doing up until now for Galactic Vault!

[p align="start"]We’ve rolled out a massive balance pass across a variety of upgrades! Below you will find all the tweaks & changes.
[p align="start"]Charms
Greed Charm: Increased credit gain from 15% -> 20%.
Vengeance Protocol: Increased damage gained per instance of damage taken from 5% -> 10% (Max damage cap remains at 80%).
Ordnance Cache: Increased grenade drop chance from 15% -> 20%, and added +1 to Max Grenades.
Flying Tiger: Now grants an additional +5% damage bonus.
[p align="start"]Magazines
Smash & Grab: Increased ammo restored on melee kills from 15% -> 25%.
Slide Loader: Increased ammo restored per second while sliding from 15% -> 25%.
Double Mag: Reduced the reload speed penalty from 20% -> 5%.
Defense Reload: Increased movement speed bonus from 15% -> 20%, and increased damage reduction from 50% -> 75%.
[p align="start"]Muzzles
Bayonet: Increased melee damage bonus from 30% -> 40%, and increased melee range bonus from 15% -> 30%.
Temporal Chamber: Decreased bullet slow effect from 60% -> 50%, but increased damage bonus from 45% -> 50%.
Salvage Strike: Increased melee lifesteal from 3% -> 6%.
Dislocator: Increased bonus damage from 40% -> 50%.
Drunkard's Barrel: Increased bonus damage from 40% -> 50%.
Bayonet Blaster: Base damage multiplier increased from 2x (Double) -> 3x (Triple), and explosion radius increased by 1m.
[p align="start"]Scopes
Spray 'n' Pray: Increased fire rate bonus from 35% -> 40%, and reduced the movement spread penalty from 25% -> 10%.
Ranger: Increased flat damage per meter from 0.05 -> 0.25.
Short Range: Increased short-range damage bonus from 40% -> 60%.
Vertical Stability: Increased recoil reduction from 15% -> 25%.
Cold Aim: Now adds +100 damage to cold bullets.
Health Extractor: Increased health drop chance per headshot from 0.5% -> 2%. Reduced the number of headshots required to reach the maximum value from 20 -> 10.
Stand My Ground: Increased shield regeneration per second from 2 -> 4.
[p align="start"]Mechanisms
Light Core: Removed the damage penalty completely. Increased movement speed bonus from 5% -> 10%, but slightly reduced the fire rate bonus from 30% -> 25%.
Counterweight: Removed the melee speed penalty completely.
Blitz: Increased movement speed bonus while shooting from 12% -> 20%.
Focus Fire: Increased spread reduction from 80% -> 85%, and maximum reduction is now reached in 1 second (down from 1.5 seconds).
Surge Core: Weapon slow-down delay extended; weapons now start slowing down after 1.5 seconds (up from 1 second).
Momentum Drive: Buff duration increased to 2 seconds, and it can now stack up to 5 times.
Charging Chamber: Increased damage bonus massively from 150% -> 400%.
Elemental Core: Increased Elemental Intensity and Buildup from 30% -> 60%.
Better Burst: Increased bonus damage on burst bullets from 25% -> 50%.
[p align="start"]Bullets
Ice: Added a new +15% bonus damage effect.
Status Intensity: Increased elemental intensity bonus from 30% -> 75%.
Elemental Buildup: Increased elemental buildup speed from 30% -> 100%.
[p align="start"]Items
Phantom Rounds: Increased extra pierces from 2 -> 3.
Reflective Shells: Increased extra bounces from 2 -> 3.
Blast Radius: Increased explosion radius bonus from +0.4m -> +1.0m.
Vampiric Efficiency: Reworked scaling. No longer grants a flat +1%, but instead provides a massive 50% efficiency increase based on your current lifesteal value.

[p align="start"]Thank you all for the incredible support, feedback, and bug reports. Jump in, test out the new characters, and let us know what you think of the Impossible Vaults and other changes!
Make sure to leave a review if you are enjoying Galactic Vault!

releases.displayName: Massive Demo Update: We are Ready for Next Fest! 🚀

items.text: [p align="start"]With Steam Next Fest kicking off this Monday, we wanted to make sure our demo is in top-tier shape. We have just pushed a massive update full of polish, fixes, and new content!
[p align="start"]Here is what you can expect in the new version:
Visuals & UI: A brand new User Interface, improved visuals, a new Intro, and overhauled VFX.
Audio: Many new sounds and general audio improvements.
Gameplay: Boss difficulty tweaks, new upgrades, and general stability optimizations.
New Content: We've unlocked 2 new skill trees in the demo: SMG & Shotgun.
Tease: We've added all the new guns to the game files... but they are locked for now. 😈
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]📺 Join our Livestream
We are planning to host a Dev Broadcast / Q&A right here on Steam during the festival. Stay tuned for an announcement regarding the exact time!
[p align="start"]Finally, if you haven't already, please consider following our developer page. It’s a small click for you, but it helps our studio grow.
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/developer/MeepMeepGames/
